prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement a disjoint-set forest in src/lib.rs. `new(n)` creates `n` singleton sets; `find(x)` returns the representative; `union(a, b)` merges the sets and returns `true` only when they were separate; `components()` returns the current number of sets. Use path compression and union by rank or size so repeated operations stay fast. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
